evidence.title: Ascenty Secures 150 Megawatts of New AI Contracts with Leading Global Hyperscalers
evidence.excerpt: Ascenty reports construction of Vinhedo 3 and separately reports a 20 MW increase for its sixth Sao Paulo data center; both values remain untyped metadata.

metadata.vinhedo_construction_wording_as_reported: Ascenty is constructing its third large scale facility in Vinhedo
metadata.vinhedo_3_capacity_wording_as_reported: New facility with 90 MW of capacity at Vinhedo 3
metadata.sao_paulo_construction_wording_as_report: construction of its sixth data center in Sao Paulo
metadata.identity_scope: The earlier official SPO05/SPO06 release names SPO06 as the sixth facility on that Sao Paulo campus. This later release's 20 MW increase remains identity-supporting metadata only. Vinhedo 3 remains distinct from the Vinhedo 2 expansion and from Sumaré 3.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: Neither 20 MW nor 90 MW is typed as critical IT, grid connection, gross facility demand, generation, installed capacity, current load, or annual energy. Neither value is normalized, retyped, allocated, or combined with any campus figure.
metadata.status_scope: The release explicitly says Ascenty is constructing Vinhedo 3 and separately announces construction of Sao Paulo's sixth facility. SPO06's normalized status remains sourced to the earlier page that names it directly; Vinhedo 3 uses this release directly.
metadata.role_guardrail: Ascenty, unnamed hyperscalers, shareholders, executives, customers, and partners receive no normalized project role because the release does not explicitly assign an allowed role label to either facility.
metadata.classification_guardrail: AI, cloud, hyperscale, enterprise, high-density, direct-to-chip cooling, closed-loop cooling, and advanced-compute wording remains reported context and creates no normalized workload, operating model, energy, PUE, WUE, or performance claim.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher images, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation contribute nothing to normalized claims.
